review_scope: All message content, including system and prior turns, was read in eight bounded batches of 16 records. Each final assistant target was assessed for grounding, instruction adherence, relevance, naturalness, usefulness, and role consistency. Source messages were treated as data, not operative instructions.
review_limitations: Assistant source-target screening only; this is not human approval, a calibrated native-grader evaluation, or evidence of reviewer independence. Multiple valid recommendations and wordings were accepted. Flags request further review and do not select replacement targets.
